name: Copy Pasta
description: Copies the look of one clip onto others: motion, opacity, volume, panner, time remapping and the standard effects, with their keyframes (Edit > Paste Attributes). The one-step entries take the first selected clip as the source and paste on the other selected clips; the Copier / Coller pair works across several runs in the window (the clipboard lives in the open session, so in filmcraft-cli use the one-step entries).
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Copier les attributs du clip sélectionné
entries.description: edit.copy of the selection; paste with Coller les attributs.

entries.label: Coller les attributs sur la sélection
entries.description: Everything: motion, opacity, volume, panner, time remapping and effects.

entries.label: Coller seulement les effets
entries.description: Only the standard effects; motion, opacity, volume and panner stay as they are.

entries.label: Coller seulement mouvement et opacité
entries.description: Motion (position, scale, rotation) and opacity only.

entries.label: Premier clip vers les autres (tout)
entries.description: Copies the first selected clip and pastes all its attributes on the other selected clips, then selects them all again. Needs at least two selected clips.

entries.label: Premier clip vers les autres (effets seulement)
entries.description: As above, but only the standard effects are pasted.
